scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hey~! Hi human~ This is Mr. Dolangmal. kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
嘿~！人類，你好呀~
我就是多朗馬爾先生，嘎嘎嘎~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We are sent to here to take you to the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
我們被派到這裡，是為了帶你去貓的天堂——^A2314B綿綿島^000000。

scripts.text: [Dolangmal]
scripts.translation: [多朗馬爾]

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How is that? The crowded city of Prontera is good, but why don't you go our heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
怎麼樣？人來人往的普隆德拉固然不錯，但要不要去我們貓的天堂——^A2314B綿綿島^000000看看？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? That place is better than Geffen, where there are only crowds of simple honest wizards.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
要不要去^A2314B綿綿島^000000看看？
那兒可比吉芬好多了，吉芬滿大街都是老實巴交的巫師。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
The fresh air of Payon is not bad, but why don't you go better place like the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
斐揚的空氣固然清新，但要不要去更好的地方——貓的天堂^A2314B綿綿島^000000看看？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Aldebaran, where it's so noisy with the tick-tock sound of the clock.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個美麗寧靜的地方，可比整天滴答滴答響個不停的艾爾帕蘭好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful and quiet place is better than Morocc, with its heat and sandstorms.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個美麗寧靜的地方，可比又熱又刮沙塵暴的夢羅克好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The beautiful place is better than Juno, which is full of books and headaches.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個美麗的地方，可比滿是書本、讓人頭疼的朱諾好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The complex place is better than Rachel, where it's too horribly quiet.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個熱鬧的地方，可比安靜得嚇人的拉赫好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The safe place is better than Lighthalzen, which is too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}那個安全的地方，可比危險的裡希塔樂鎮好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
{0}The smell of this sea place is better than Mora, which is full of a grassy smell.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
{0}這裡的海洋氣息，可比滿是青草味的穆拉好多了。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~ Go~ Go~

[Dolangmal]
What!? You don't want to go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
什麼！？你不想去^A2314B綿綿島^000000？
切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you don't go, why did you talk to me... but...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
你這傢伙真麻煩。
不想去還來搭什麼話...不過...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
^9E1837托馬斯提督^000000說要把人類綁架過去...不對...是禮貌地請過去？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Whenever you want to go, just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
行吧，我知道了。
想去的時候，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! I like your attitude. Full of passion.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好！就喜歡你這股熱情勁兒！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Now, before you go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, let me give you some warnings.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
那麼，在你去^A2314B綿綿島^000000之前，我先給你幾點忠告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
First!! It is natural that when you arrive on ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, you should notify ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 that you are here.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
第一！！到了^A2314B綿綿島^000000，當然得先找^9E1837托馬斯提督^000000報到。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you don't do that, you might be attacked by scary and wild cats when you walk through dark streets.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
如果不這麼做，你走在黑暗的街道上時，可能會被兇猛可怕的野貓襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Secondly!! This ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 is absolutely our island of cats, even though we open to humans.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
第二！！雖然^A2314B綿綿島^000000對人類開放，但這裡終究是我們貓的島嶼。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We have a personality... no... no... respect us like one catality because we are cats.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
我們也是有人格的...不對，不對...我們是貓，請尊重我們的“貓格”！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And the next one is...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
然後下一條是...

scripts.text: Dolangmal proceeds and gives hundreds of warnings.
scripts.translation: 多朗馬爾滔滔不絕地講了幾百條忠告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Those are all the warnings!! They're easy and simple... right? Can you remember them?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好！忠告就這些！！
都很簡單明瞭...對吧？
記住了嗎？

scripts.text: Remember his warnings
scripts.translation: 記住他的忠告

scripts.text: Can't remember
scripts.translation: 記不住

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Do not bite two mice with one mouth. ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 is located at the ^A2314Bcenter of the ship in Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好！可別一張嘴咬兩隻老鼠，說話不算話哦。
^9E1837托馬斯提督^000000就在^A2314B綿綿島的船中央^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Don't forget to give him notice of your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
別忘了向他報到。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Alright. Let's go to the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好了。我們去貓的天堂——^A2314B綿綿島^000000吧~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
What!? Can't you keep these easy rules? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
什麼！？這麼簡單的規矩都守不住？
切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you can't keep these, why didn't you tell me during our conversation? I told you everything... but..
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
你這傢伙真麻煩。
守不住規矩，剛才怎麼不早說？
害我全講完了...不過...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
^9E1837托馬斯提督^000000說要把人類綁架過去...不對...是禮貌地請過去？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Just tell me whenever you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
行吧，我知道了。
想去的時候，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Uh? You must be the one from last time...? Alright. Did you visit ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
咦？你是上次那個人...？
對了，你去過^A2314B綿綿島^000000了嗎？

scripts.text: Take me to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 again
scripts.translation: 再帶我去一次^A2314B綿綿島^000000

scripts.text: I have visited
scripts.translation: 我去過了

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
I really want to send you there, but I can't because of the policy. It is difficult to send people who have visited ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 already.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
我也想送你去，可規定不允許。
已經去過^A2314B綿綿島^000000的人，我不能再送了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And that was roughly it... It's supposed to be rule 53...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
大概就是這麼回事...應該是第53條規定...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Actually, let me tell you rule 53. I am an indulgent cat.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
好吧，我就告訴你第53條。
誰讓我是一隻寬宏大量的貓呢。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, take the ship at Izlude or Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
如果你想再去^A2314B綿綿島^000000，就到依斯魯得島或艾爾貝塔坐船。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you enjoy that pleasant sea trip, you will arrive at the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
享受一段愉快的海上旅程，你就會抵達貓的天堂——^A2314B綿綿島^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
So easy! Isn't it? Well, good bye~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
很簡單吧？那麼，再見~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How was it? You liked it? I knew it. Kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
怎麼樣？喜歡吧？
我就知道，嘎嘎嘎~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ah! I just want to make sure...
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
啊！我再確認一下...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Again, if you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, do you know where to take a ship at Izlude or Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
再確認一次，要回^A2314B綿綿島^000000的話，你知道去依斯魯得或艾爾貝塔哪裡坐船吧？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hm~ You might know because you're a smart person. Well, see you again~
scripts.translation:
[多朗馬爾]
嗯~你這麼聰明，肯定知道。
那下次見啦~

scripts.text: This cat is sleeping in the warm {0} sun.
scripts.translation: 這隻貓正在{0}暖洋洋的陽光下睡覺。

scripts.text: Let him sleep
scripts.translation: 讓它睡吧

scripts.text: Talk to him
scripts.translation: 跟它說話

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Meow? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
喵？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
You are a hero of cat's fleet. Your activity is the legend between us.
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
您可是貓艦隊的英雄，您的事蹟在我們當中都成了傳說。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
As you are a hero of the cat fleet let me send you to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 for free.
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
您是貓艦隊的英雄，我就免費送您去^A2314B綿綿島^000000吧。

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去綿綿島！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Have a comfortable trip... Alright let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
祝您一路舒舒服服的...好，出發~

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
{0}

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去綿綿島！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Money? Where is the money? You can't go anywhere without the money. Shame on you.
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
錢呢？錢在哪兒？
沒錢可哪兒都去不了，真不像話。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Let me send you right away. Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奧德格納拉姆]
這就送您過去，出發~

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Did you have fun in Malangdo?
The fleet has a service to Izlude and Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您在綿綿島玩得開心嗎？
我們船隊有開往依斯魯得島和艾爾貝塔的航線。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
The fee of ship is only 1000 zeny, where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
船費只需1000 Zeny，您想去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
You have a connection with our fleet. Apply special price 999 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您和我們船隊有交情，就算您特價999 Zeny。
您想去哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Wow~ You contributed to our fleet a lot. Alright!! Special discount price 500 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
哇~您為我們船隊出了不少力！
好，就給您特別優惠價500 Zeny！
您想去哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Ah... You are the legendary hero of our cat's fleet.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
啊...您就是我們貓艦隊的傳奇英雄。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
We can't charge the hero of our fleet. What is your destination?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
哪能收我們船隊英雄的錢呢。
您想去哪兒？

scripts.text: - Izlude destination --- {0}
scripts.translation: - 前往依斯魯得島 --- {0}

scripts.text: - Alberta destination --- {0}
scripts.translation: - 前往艾爾貝塔 --- {0}

scripts.text: - Stay on Malangdo
scripts.translation: - 留在綿綿島

scripts.text:
[Kong]
{0}

[Kong]
Have a comfortable trip.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
{0}

[Kong]
{0}

You see a lazy cat standing on a chair.
You guess that this is the Innkeeper.
scripts.translation:
你看到一隻懶洋洋的貓站在椅子上。
你猜它就是旅店老闆。

scripts.text: Umm... Can I rest here?
scripts.translation: 嗯...我可以在這裡休息嗎？

scripts.text: Psst... Can I save here?
scripts.translation: 噓...我可以在這裡存檔嗎？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Eh?
Uh, sure you can use this hammock if you give me ^FF00005 Malangdo Cans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
嗯？
呃，給我^FF00005個綿綿島風味罐頭^000000，這張吊床就讓你用。

scripts.text: Here you go.
scripts.translation: 給你

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Now relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
好好放鬆吧。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
This ain't no charity.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
我這可不是做慈善的。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Let me know if you want to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
如果你想放鬆，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Location saved. We should keep company, haha~
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
存檔完成。以後常來往啊，哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Sometimes you just have to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
有時候就是得放鬆一下。

scripts.text: - Wow, this is the laziest cat ever. -
scripts.translation: - 哇，真沒見過這麼懶的貓。 -

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Boy, that lazy cat makes me want to just nap all day long.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
哎呀，看著那隻懶貓，我也只想整天睡大覺。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
He makes life look so simple.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
看它這樣，日子過得可真簡單。

scripts.text:
[Wanderer]
The cats living in here are so energetic.
Is it weird that they make me want to dance all day?
La di dah di dah~!
scripts.translation:
[浪姬舞者]
住在這裡的貓都好有活力。
看著它們就想跳上一整天，我是不是有點奇怪？
啦哩噠哩噠~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Ooo~ their soft puffy tails and soft fur~
I can't stand it, this is heaven~~!!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
噢~蓬鬆柔軟的尾巴，軟乎乎的毛~
受不了了，這裡簡直是天堂~~！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
My hidden card, ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000, can make all cats in Malangdo my slaves~ haha!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
我的王牌——^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000，能讓綿綿島所有的貓都成為我的奴隸~哈哈！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?

[Cat Trainer]
It is such a rare item!
I can barely get it.
But these cudly cats can't resist it~
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
那可是非常稀有的東西！
我也很難弄到。
但這些可愛的貓咪對它毫無抵抗力~

scripts.text: Where can I get ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?
scripts.translation: 哪裡能弄到^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000？

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Why would I tell you when I can barely get it?
I wouldn't even tell you for all the zeny in the world~!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
我本來就很難弄到，為什麼要告訴你？
就算給我全世界的Zeny我也不會說~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
All the Malangdo cats are mine~!
Muahahahaha~
With enough ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000 I can be a queen in Malangdo~ ohhhh!!!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
綿綿島所有的貓都是我的~！
哇哈哈哈哈~
只要有足夠的^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000，我就能成為綿綿島的女王~噢噢噢！！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Ooo~ their soft puffy tails and soft fur~
I can't stand it, this is heaven~~!!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
噢~蓬鬆柔軟的尾巴，軟乎乎的毛~
受不了了，這裡簡直是天堂~~！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
This is my little secret called
^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000. I can use
it to make the Malangdo cats my
slaves~ muahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
我的小秘密，就叫^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000。
有了它，綿綿島的貓都會乖乖當我的奴隸~哇哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?

[Cat Trainer]
Hmm, I guess it's no wonder you don't know.
These Malangdo cats can't resist it.
But it's too rare of an item to get so you shouldn't bother trying to find it.
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
嗯，你不知道也不奇怪。
綿綿島的貓對它毫無抵抗力。
不過它太稀有了，你還是別費勁去找了。

scripts.text: Where can I get ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?
scripts.translation: 哪裡能弄到^FF0000獼猴桃果實^000000？

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Actually, it's simple. You just...
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
其實很簡單，你只要...

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Hey, you almost made me tell my secret.
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
嘿，你差點讓我把秘密說漏嘴了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
One day these cats will be mine.
I can be a king in Malangdo~ ohhh~!
scripts.translation:
[馴貓師]
總有一天，這些貓都會是我的。
我就能當上綿綿島的國王啦~噢噢~！
